name: Inn by the Sea
insider_take: This coastal gem sits on 57 pristine acres overlooking Crescent Beach State Park, where you can literally walk from your room to one of Maine's most beautiful sandy beaches in minutes.
whats_special: The Inn is just 7 miles from Portland Head Light, Maine's oldest lighthouse commissioned by George Washington in 1791. The property features an award-winning Sea Glass Restaurant and is one of only a handful of pet-friendly luxury resorts in New England, complete with a dedicated dog beach and spa treatments for your four-legged friends.
pro_tip: Book a boardwalk cottage for direct beach access and unobstructed ocean views. The best lobster rolls in the area are found at The Lobster Shack at Two Lights, just a 5-minute drive away near the iconic Twin Lights.
dont_miss: Sunset at Portland Head Light (especially during golden hour), tide pooling at nearby Kettle Cove, and the Inn's signature blueberry pancakes made with wild Maine blueberries. Cape Elizabeth is also home to the historic Goddard Mansion ruins, perfect for an adventurous morning hike.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with direct beach access
Pet-friendly with dedicated dog amenities and services
Farm-to-table dining with locally sourced ingredients
cons: Remote coastal location requiring transportation for activities
Seasonal weather limitations for outdoor activities
